text: This free RPG demo is thirteen gigs on your drive.
It's Everlast: Undying Tale, an MMO-lite you can play solo or with friends.
Fight the undead, then mine, chop trees, craft at the anvil, or just go fishing.
Best part: the world. Bright flower fields, swamps, and caves full of glowing mushrooms.
You can even glide off a cliff, straight into a fight.
The catch? The trailer is pre-alpha footage, and the animations look stiff.
It's English only, and the full game is aimed at the end of this year.
Worth a dip if you've got the space.
